query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: performance_vs_advertised_spec
per_column.rationale: A meaningful axis for complaints (misrepresentation, falling short). But it requires an advertised spec that most reviews lack; 'not_present' dominates (142), and applying 'meets_spec' to reviews like AMZ-0004/0005 that make no reference to any advertised specification is a mild over-reading. Values are otherwise defensible when a spec is discussed.

per_column.name: content_quality_aspect
per_column.rationale: Genuine grouping axis for media reviews (writing, production, pacing). Values track the text well: AMZ-0002 correctly tagged plot_story_writing. 'not_present' for non-media items (doll, cream) is correct silent behaviour. Reasonable groundedness.

per_column.name: expectation_gap_direction
per_column.rationale: Directly on-query: whether products met/exceeded/fell short of expectations is a strong driver of praise vs complaint. Values align with text (AMZ-0001 fell_short, AMZ-0004 pleasantly_exceeded). AMZ-0005 'met_expectations' is a slightly conservative but sound reading of a strongly positive review.

per_column.name: intended_use_fit
per_column.rationale: Useful fit-for-purpose axis. But some values overreach: AMZ-0002 'partial_fit_conditional' is a strained mapping of a book-quality complaint, and AMZ-0001's doll-availability complaint isn't really 'wrong_for_use_case'. The frame is imposed on reviews that don't discuss a use case, weakening groundedness.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_intensity
per_column.rationale: A tone-intensity scale can help model why reviews are emphatic, but it is a fairly generic affect measure and highly subjective. Values are plausible but not verifiable from text; the ranking is a judgment call rather than a clear reading, so leverage and groundedness are moderate.

per_column.name: recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: Strong, clearly-grounded axis: explicit recommend / do-not-recommend / conditional / none. Values match text well (AMZ-0002 'not enough to make me recommend it' -> do_not_recommend; AMZ-0004/0005 recommend). Directly relevant to praise vs complaint drivers.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide several genuine, non-redundant axes (expectation gap, recommendation stance, content quality aspect, fit-for-purpose) that directly serve the query about drivers of praise and complaints. Groundedness is generally sound, with correct 'not_present' handling for silent rows. The main weaknesses are the spec- and use-case-oriented columns imposing frames on reviews that lack them (occasional over-reading), and the emotional-intensity scale being generic and subjective. No systematic invention of facts, but a few mild over-confident mappings lower groundedness slightly.
